caption: The drawing depicts a mortar and pestle placed centrally on a plain, light-colored background. The mortar is a rounded vessel, colored in warm shades of brown and orange, with a slightly flared rim and a base. The base of the mortar appears to be circular, painted in a bluish tone that contrasts with the upper brown section. Resting inside the mortar is a pestle, which is cylindrical and positioned diagonally with one end inside the bowl and the other end protruding upwards to the right. The pestle is rendered in a light blue color, with highlights indicating its smooth surface. On the lower right corner of the image, the name "JANET RIZA" is typed, and there is a small scale ruler to the lower left of the drawing. The composition is simple and centered, with the objects occupying the middle portion of the page.
title: Mortar and Pestle
